stories.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican four days after lung cancer surgery
stories.brief: Pope Leo left the hospital in Rome on Saturday afternoon and returned to the Vatican four days after ‌surgery for lung cancer, an illness that has prompted speculation about how it might affect his 17-month papacy.

stories.title: Morris wins omnium gold for Great Britain
stories.brief: Great Britain's Anna Morris wins gold in the women's omnium at the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
stories.brief: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.(Image credit: Andrew Medichini)

stories.title: Attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure pose risks to Pakistan's economic outlook: FinMin Aurangzeb
stories.brief: In an interview on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Aurangzeb said Pakistan had procured enough energy supplies to last through November, and was now planning for the winter months, when household needs typically spike.

stories.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
stories.brief: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?
stories.brief: Tesla CEO Elon Musk showcased the vehicle at a facility owned by his SpaceX company, which helped develop the model.

stories.title: Smiling pope returns to Vatican after cancer surgery
stories.brief: Pope Leo XIV left the hospital to enthusiastic cheers and applause from well-wishers and returned home to the Vatican on Saturday, four days after undergoing surgery for lung cancer.

stories.title: GB's Morris completes hat-trick of golds at Worlds
stories.brief: Britain's Anna Morris completes a hat-trick of gold medals at the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai.

stories.title: Morris completes golden hat-trick alongside Boothman in madison
stories.brief: Anna Morris secures a hat-trick of gold medals at the Track Cycling World Championships as she wins the women's madison for Great Britain with Erin Boothman.

stories.title: Govt notifies 48-member Area Representative and Development Council for 12 K-P districts
stories.brief: The federal government on Saturday formally notified the establishment of the 48-member Area Representative and Development Council (ARDC) across 12 districts of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) as the governor consolidated his rule in the province.

stories.title: Two police head constables martyred in attack in Balochistan’s Nasirabad
stories.brief: Two police head constables were martyred when unidentified armed men opened fire on a police patrol in Balochistan’s Nasirabad district on Saturday. Police told The Express Tribune that the incident occurred near Bedar Bridge, where the motorcycle-riding officers were on routine patrol.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz says govt had ‘no other option’ but to impose emergency or witness bloodshed in K-P
stories.brief: Turning to the situation in K-P, the prime minister said he had held several meetings with the province’s former chief minister and also with Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, making what he described as sincere efforts to address the issues facing the province.

stories.title: Fazl seeks joint in-camera session as ministers reject 'spoils of war' charge
stories.brief: Speaking to reporters in Lahore, Fazl urged the government to convene an in-camera session of parliament to brief lawmakers on the security situation and its counterterrorism strategy, questioning why the nation was not being taken into confidence.

stories.title: Iran offers help to end Saudi-Houthi conflict through dialogue
stories.brief: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Saturday that Tehran supports a “political process” to resolve the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthi rebels.
